clusters.headline: Microsoft Reports Global Service Outages Affecting Multiple Platforms
aiSummaryBullets: Microsoft is addressing a significant global disruption impacting multiple core service platforms.
Services experiencing connectivity issues include Microsoft Teams, Outlook, and the Copilot artificial intelligence software.

clusters.headline: Nairobi Police Conduct Raid On Illegal Alcohol Production Site
aiSummaryBullets: Law enforcement officials in Nairobi confiscated 2,060 litres of illicit alcohol.
The operation occurred in the Soweto area of Kahawa West on November 12.

clusters.headline: Nairobi Authorities Arrest Robbery Suspect And Recover Firearm
aiSummaryBullets: Police from the South B Station arrested one suspect involved in an armed robbery.
Officers recovered a loaded homemade firearm during a search following the incident.

clusters.headline: Kenya Discharges Final Ebola Patient As Disease-Free Status Nears
aiSummaryBullets: Kenya has successfully discharged the last of its nine confirmed Ebola patients from hospital care.
Health authorities have officially initiated a 42-day observation period to monitor for any potential resurgence of the virus.

clusters.headline: Missing Kenyan Lawyer Abshir Abdi Found Alive In Northern Region
aiSummaryBullets: Lawyer Abshir Abdi has been located alive after a period of disappearance.
Initial reports suggest he was discovered in the Marsabit and Isiolo areas.

clusters.headline: President Ruto Nominates New Data Commissioner And State CEOs
aiSummaryBullets: President William Ruto has nominated Lydia Sitienei Chelagat to serve as the new Data Commissioner.
The nomination has been submitted to the Kenyan Parliament for formal review and consideration.

clusters.headline: President Ruto Criticizes Gachagua Regarding Young Political Leaders
aiSummaryBullets: President William Ruto publicly urged former Deputy President Rigathi Gachagua to cease interfering with the careers of young politicians.
The President stated his intention to support upcoming leadership and pledged to hand over power to a younger generation in 2032.

clusters.headline: Former Cabinet Secretary Aisha Jumwa Rejoins United Democratic Party
aiSummaryBullets: Aisha Jumwa has formally returned to President William Ruto's United Democratic Alliance party.
The move follows her three-month departure to join the Wiper party.

clusters.headline: President Ruto Concludes Gusii Tour Amidst Heated Political Debate
aiSummaryBullets: President William Ruto concluded a four-day development tour of the Gusii region.
The President criticized former President Uhuru Kenyatta, describing him as a political broker for the opposition.

clusters.headline: Kenyan Cult Leader Receives 200 Year Sentence For Shakahola Deaths
aiSummaryBullets: Paul Mackenzie was sentenced to 200 years in prison for his role in the deaths of 191 individuals.
The judicial decision follows a conviction on 191 counts of murder issued by the court on October 19, 2026.
